extracted.intended_audience: researchers applying for EPA STAR grants; peer reviewers and EPA program staff
extracted.subtask_short: EPA STAR grant peer review criteria
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluation criteria and review process used by EPA's Science to Achieve Results (STAR) program to assess scientific quality and mission relevance of research grant proposals through a two-tier peer and relevance review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Approach (overall standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must propose EPA mission relevant research based on excellent science as determined through peer review by experts drawn from the national and international scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should simultaneously demonstrate scientific excellence and clear linkage to EPA mission; peer review by independent experts determines 'excellent science.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Tier 1: Quality Peer Review (rating scale)
rubrics_metrics.description: A panel of independent scientific experts evaluates each proposal for scientific quality, rating proposals as: Excellent; Very Good; Good; Fair; Poor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Peer reviewers focus on scientific merit and quality. Only proposals rated 'Excellent' or 'Very Good' proceed to the relevance review. The rating scale (Excellent → Poor) is the primary measure of scientific quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tier 2: Relevance Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Following peer review, EPA staff conducts a 'relevance review' limited to proposals rated as 'excellent' or 'very good' to assess relevance to EPA's mission and programmatic priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relevance review evaluates linkage to EPA strategic priorities and program needs. Note: the program funds NO proposals rated below 'very good' (i.e., proposals rated Good, Fair, or Poor are not funded regardless of relevance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientific merit of the proposed research, including originality and significance of hypotheses, and soundness of approach and methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers assess whether the scientific question is important and novel, hypotheses are well-founded, and the methodological approach is appropriate and rigorous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of innovative concepts and approaches and demonstration of creative problem solving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should describe how the work goes beyond existing methods or ideas and present novel approaches or concepts that advance the field or address problems in new ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigator Qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Track record of the PI and team and the adequacy of facilities and resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluations consider the team's prior accomplishments, expertise relevant to the project, and whether institutional support, facilities, and resources are sufficient to execute the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Plan/Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Realistic milestones and timelines, appropriate sample sizes and statistical power, and plans for risk mitigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should present clear, feasible timelines with measurable milestones, justify sample size and power calculations, and identify potential risks with mitigation strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation of quality assurance and quality control consistent with EPA requirements for STAR grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals must address how QA/QC will be implemented and documented; follow EPA guidance on satisfying STAR Grant quality requirements (e.g., QA plans, data management, validation procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to EPA Mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Linkage to EPA strategic plan, application to environmental decision-making, and stakeholder engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should explicitly state how the research informs environmental decision-making, aligns with EPA strategic priorities, and includes plans for engaging relevant stakeholders or end-users.
